summary: startApi refused with 326 against request id -1, the way a client id already in use is refused.

provenance.why: Opening a second connection on a client id already in use is not a read-only market-data request, so it was not asked of the gateway here. CLAUDE.md also records that IB Gateway lets a second connection on one id DISPLACE the first in silence, so whether this gateway sends 326 at all is unverified.
provenance.built: normal-with-greeks' greeting (recorded 2026-11-09), then IBKR's documented 326 and its documented text, against request id -1, where a fault that belongs to no request is reported. The text is IBKR's wording, not captured.

onStartApi: Unable to connect as the client id is already in use. Retry with a unique client id.
